context: Law enforcement economy: It means that the government department has huge discretion when enforcing the law, and its jurisdiction has considerable economic benefits.
question: Which of the following disputes are caused by "law enforcement economy":
options: Eight law enforcement officers of a city's industrial and commercial bureau and several law enforcement officers of the city's health and epidemic prevention station scuffled in front of a grocery store for a case of milk powder.
Xiao Li is unwilling to stop at the free parking lot designated by the traffic police and has a dispute with the traffic police
In a farmer's market, hawkers arbitrarily set up stalls and refused to accept the management to quarrel with the administrator
The doorman of a residential area has strict management of vehicles entering and leaving the area, and often fines. Some owners are very dissatisfied and often quarrel with the doorman.
label: a

context: There are four bookstores in the city of A. B, and D. Among them, all the books in A and B can be found in B and B. Books sold in B and B must also be sold in C and B, and some books in C and B are also sold in D.
question: It can be inferred from this:
options: Some books in A bookstore can be found in B bookstore
Some books in B Bookstore can be found in Ding Bookstore
All the books in Ding Bookstore can be found in B Bookstore
All books in Bookstore A can be found in Bookstore C

context: Experts believe that the family atmosphere is not harmonious, and the lack of parental care is one of the reasons that cause young people to experience mental and spiritual problems and then become online fans. The family is the key place for children to experience emotions and develop emotional intelligence. Sense, respect, intimacy and love, children are likely to escape fear and loneliness in online games and seek comfort. Fathers who are busy working and mothers who love to criticize are often "good at" creating such an emotional ecology. If one is full of adventure spirit When a boy who seeks excitement lives a monotonous and immutable life, the online game world naturally looks wonderful and infinite.
question: The main points of this passage are:
options: Children's emotional supply should be guaranteed as much as possible
Emotional absence makes children addicted to online games
The harmonious parent-child relationship can keep children out of online games
Create an emotional ecology that meets the personality of the child
label: b

context: Da Li knows Mr. Zhang's friend Xiao Wang, and Xiao Wang knows Da Li's friend Ms. Lin. Anyone who knows Xiao Wang has a master's degree in public administration, and anyone who knows Ms. Lin is from Jiangsu.

context: It was snowing and many highways were closed in succession. Some highway managers believed that if the highways were not closed, major traffic accidents would occur, causing huge losses to people's lives and property. However, many drivers did not agree with this view.
question: Based on this, which of the following judgments is most likely to be a view agreed by these drivers?
options: Driving at high speed on a snow-covered highway is prone to accidents
Traffic accidents are inevitable, highways are closed, and major traffic accidents may occur on ordinary highways
No major traffic accidents will occur if the highway is not closed
The closer the highway is closed, the more the snow and ice will not melt: the snow and ice will not melt easily, the more the highway will be closed
label: b

context: Private companies attract high-skilled professionals by offering high salaries. Most professional technicians employed in private companies make 50% more money than professionals with similar skills who work in government departments. The professional technicians hired are driven more by the public's sense of responsibility than by their personal interests, otherwise the government's professional technicians may be lost to private enterprises.
question: Which of the following assumptions is necessary for the above discussion? ?
options: Government-hired professional and technical personnel have a greater sense of public responsibility than those of private enterprises
Compared with private enterprises, the government does not provide professional technicians with better conditions other than salary, such as a better working environment or benefits.
Professional and technical personnel will measure both personal interests and public duties
Professional and technical personnel working in private enterprises work much longer than professional and technical personnel working in government
label: b

context: The function of the government is to meet the real needs of the masses. Unless the government knows what those needs are, the government cannot meet those needs. Free speech ensures that government officials hear such demand information. Therefore, for a healthy country, speech Freedom is essential.
question: Which of the following, if true, cannot weaken the conclusion of the above argument?
options: In most cases, people don't know what they really need.
Free speech ultimately tends to undermine social order, and good social order is a prerequisite for meeting the needs of the masses.
The proper function of government is not to meet the needs of the people, but to provide them with equal opportunities.
Free speech is inadequate to meet the needs of the masses, and a good social order is also essential.
label: d

context: Kong, Chen, Meng, and Liu from a certain unit need to be assigned to the four villages A. B, C, and D to carry out poverty alleviation work, and each person goes to a village. According to the work needs, the allocation meets the following conditions: If you go to Jia village, then Liu goes to Ding village; (2) either Chen to B village or Meng to B village, only one of which is established; (3) Meng Quding village.
question: If the above conditions are met, which of the following can be concluded?
options: Kong go to D village, Liu go to A village
Kong go to A village, Liu go to C village
Kong go to C village, Liu go to B village
Kong go to B village, Liu go to C village

context: A primary school applied to the local education administration for the purchase of an additional school bus to strengthen the ability to transfer teachers and students. The education administration rejected this application on the grounds that the number of school buses must be proportional to the size of the school and the number of teachers and students According to the school's current number and scale of teachers and students, the existing school bus is sufficient.
question: Which of the following assumptions best supports the decision of the education administration?
options: Survey shows that renting a school bus is more economical than buying a school bus
There will be no vehicles scrapped at least in the near future.
The number of primary school-age children in the region will not increase significantly in the future
The education administration has no plan to expand the school's teachers and students
label: d

context: A company plans to implement an "office-home, ButoneDay" plan, that is, all employees do not need to work in the office, they can choose any place they want to complete the work, such as home, playground . . . Colleagues must one day meet in the office for face-to-face communication.
question: Which of the following explanation best illustrates the need for face-to-face communication?
options: Face-to-face communication can help employees evaluate work progress
Face-to-face communication can obtain some key non-verbal communication information
Without the face-to-face communication in the office, the office loses its value
Working independently for a long time without communicating with other colleagues will weaken the team spirit of employees

context: Water tourism is a short-term experience with social, leisure, and consumer attributes when people travel to the water and surrounding areas to seek pleasure. options: Wuyi Mountain's "Jiuquxi" can be found everywhere
On the street on the bank of Qinhuai River, there is a "Gangnan Gongyuan" built in the Ming Dynasty.
A forest park has a "release pond" stocking thousands of koi
A building stands on the bank of the Yangtze River, becoming a background for tourists to take pictures

context: Generally speaking, there are two types of expressions about the world, the first is an empirical expression, but it is true to make a statement about what the world looks like. The second is a normative expression, which makes about what the world should look like Expressions usually include value judgments, that is, making good or bad judgments or not.
question: Based on the above definition, Which of the following judgments are correct:
options: "Raising the exchange rate will reduce inflation is wrong" is an empirical statement
"Government legislation is correct to ban smoking in public places" is an empirical statement
"The sharing of gasoline tax is too unfair for drivers" is the normative statement
"If the government raises wine taxes, the benefits of wineries will decrease" is the normative statement
label: c

context: Birds usually dodge unusual things and like green and blue objects. But when researchers injected sheep's red blood cells at 4 weeks, 9 weeks, and 14 weeks to simulate a parasite infection, The birds then began to explore new things in the environment and move closer to the little orange toys--they usually stay away from this color because it seems to be related to toxic food. The researchers speculate that these so-called personality changes will help Adult individuals explore larger areas and find more food, which in turn can compensate for the energy they lose as they fight infectious diseases.
question: Which of the following, if true, cannot question the researchers' speculation?
options: een food does not provide energy for the little mallard.
Adult individuals with small mallards exploring larger areas mean more danger
through long-term observation, it is found that the small green duck injected with red blood cells is more aggressive
Sheep red blood cell release protein binds to the retinal cells of the little mallard and affects its color recognition.
label: c

There is a close relationship between a good mood and a person's physical health
Lower blood pressure and oxidation indicate that the person is in a bad mood
As long as you are happy, you can improve your entire metabolism

context: In one study, researchers found that the stereotype of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (chronic obstructive pneumonia) is so ingrained that women with this disease may not be diagnosed in time. In the initial examination, only 49% of women were diagnosed with COPD, compared with 64. 6% of men. A medical test report pointing to COPD was provided. At this time, the gender gap in the diagnosis rate narrowed, but it still did not completely disappear.
question: The "stereotype" in the passage refers to
options: Women are less likely to have COPD
Women with COPD are not easily diagnosed
Men are more likely to have COPD
COPD is easily diagnosed in men
label: a

context: In recent years, especially in first-tier cities, the proportion of buyers who bought first-hand new homes rather than second-hand homes has fallen, and some buyers believe that this is due to the rise in first-hand new home prices. options: The value of new home purchases drops much faster than the value of second-hand homes
The decline in the proportion of buyers of new homes must mean that the proportion of buyers of second-hand homes has increased
The relative increase in second-hand home sales may be explained by the decision of only a small percentage of all home buyers
